items.title: This old Nokia phone got an AI Upgrade it was never designed for
items.excerpt: A Turkish developer vibe-coded 'Claude S40', an app that lets a 2G Nokia 6300 talk to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok via a small Go server, with a reading mode and offline saving of responses.

items.title: Ollama brings free, local text-to-speech to your Mac with natural-sounding AI voices
items.excerpt: Ollama now lets Mac users turn text into natural-sounding speech locally with Phonon, a family of small text-to-speech models from Gradium. No subscription required.

items.title: Opera wants websites to run AI on your laptop instead of sending your data to the cloud
items.excerpt: Opera’s WebAI preview lets websites and extensions use AI models running locally on supported computers, avoiding cloud processing and separate subscriptions while leaving access under the user’s control through site-specific permissions.

items.title: Apple refreshes the iMac with M6 chip, faster AI performance, and Wi-Fi 7
items.excerpt: Apple’s refreshed iMac brings M6 power, faster AI, Wi-Fi 7, and improved connectivity, starting at $1,499.

items.title: Apple MacBook Pro M6 just unveiled with 30% faster graphics, 25% faster AI and up to 24 hours of battery life
items.excerpt: Apple's new 14-inch MacBook Pro moves to the M6 chip, which Apple says brings 30% faster graphics and 25% faster AI performance, plus up to 24 hours of battery life.

items.title: Google's working on a new look for Gemini Live, and we have a sneak peek for you
items.excerpt: Google is testing a Neural Expressive-inspired Gemini Live redesign with a circular visualizer, animated dots, and a blue glow.

items.title: Google is building a home for everything you've asked Gemini to remember
items.excerpt: Google is working on a new Gemini feature that could let you easily view and manage text and images you've asked it to remember.

items.title: Gemini Live redesign makes it easier to add context to chats
items.excerpt: Following the other big interface updates this month, Google is rolling out a small 'plus' redesign to Gemini Live on Android...

items.title: INMO GO3 smart glasses pack a display and Gemini integration with clever camera privacy
items.excerpt: INMO GO3 smart glasses put a display in the lens with real-time translation across 98 languages (13 offline) and an assistant powered by Gemini and ChatGPT, plus swappable batteries and a physical camera privacy shade.

items.title: Google Maps on CarPlay rolling out Gemini when navigating
items.excerpt: Google Maps in CarPlay now lets you access Gemini when using navigation for a conversational driving experience.

items.title: Intel Arc B580 runs 125B AI model nearly 3x faster with XeStrata in new test
items.excerpt: Intel's 12GB Arc B580 delivered 31.1 tokens per second when running a 125-billion-parameter AI model with XeStrata, compared with 10.9 tokens per second using Strata. The result highlights the impact of inference software, although the test PC also required 64GB of RAM.

items.title: [Hands-On] Comfort, Convenience, and More: A Day With Galaxy Buds On
items.excerpt: Samsung's first clip-on open-ear Galaxy Buds On launch in Korea with hands-free Gemini Live ('Hey Google, let's talk Live'), head-gesture call handling and up to 9.5 hours of playback.

items.title: Samsung to Launch First Clip-On Galaxy Buds Earphones
items.excerpt: Samsung launches Galaxy Buds On, its first clip-on Galaxy Buds, in Korea on Oct. 27 at 299,000 won, with Gemini Live support when paired with a Galaxy AI phone; global markets follow.

items.title: Samsung has new clip-on buds, OnePlus has new clip-on buds — when do we say 'that's enough new open earbuds'?
